name: data-modeling
description: Skills for designing data models, starting with Amazon DynamoDB tables, keys, indexes and access patterns.

interface.shortDescription: Design DynamoDB tables from access patterns
interface.longDescription: Skills for designing data models. designing-dynamodb-tables leads a design from entities and access patterns to table boundaries, primary keys and secondary indexes, applies relationship, filtering, sorting, integrity, scaling and migration strategies, writes an entity chart and an access-pattern chart, and checks the design against current AWS limits.
defaultPrompt: Design the DynamoDB table for this feature.
Add this access pattern to our DynamoDB table.
